facts.angel-trumpet: An angel in the clouds blows a gold trumpet with a white banner marked with a red cross.
facts.red-wings: The angel has reddish wings and golden curly hair.
facts.rising-figures: Below, people rise from open coffins, some spreading both arms and some looking up.
facts.family-front: In front are a man (left), a child with their back turned (center), and a woman (right).
facts.more-behind: Three more rise from the coffins behind, making six in all.
facts.water-mountains: The coffins float on water, and snow-capped mountains can be seen behind.
facts.grey-bodies: The people's bodies are painted a grayish color.

glosses.rising-figures: The moment of shedding the past and standing up again.
glosses.family-front: Not alone, but waking up together.

reversedGloss.blocked: Knowing the call that must be answered, but putting it off.
reversedGloss.internalized: A resolve is growing inside before it shows outside.
reversedGloss.excess: Going over the past again and again and passing judgment on oneself.

misdescriptions.wrong: The angel holds scales and passes judgment.
